Good to Know

Frequently asked questions

Which areas do you deliver to?
We deliver across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, including F-6, F-7, F-10, F-11, G-9, G-13, DHA, Bahria Town, Satellite Town and Saddar. If your area is not listed, message us on WhatsApp and we will do our best.
What is the cutoff for same-day delivery?
We are open 24/7, so there is no hard cutoff. Order at least 2 hours ahead for guaranteed same-day delivery; for most areas of Islamabad we can often deliver even faster.
How does midnight delivery work?
Choose the midnight slot at checkout (or tell us on WhatsApp) and our rider will reach the address at 12:00 AM on the date you pick. Perfect for birthdays and anniversaries. A small midnight delivery fee applies.
How can I pay?
We accept bank transfer, JazzCash and Easypaisa. Once you place your order, we share the payment details on WhatsApp and confirm as soon as payment is received.
Can I get a custom bouquet made?
Yes. Send us a photo or describe the colours and flowers you have in mind on WhatsApp, and our florists will design a custom arrangement within your budget.
Is the gift message card free?
Yes, every order includes a free handwritten gift card. Just write your message when you order and we will attach it to the bouquet before delivery.

A birthday at midnight? We are already awake.

Message us any time — day or night — and we will arrange something beautiful within the hour.
